banner: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
objective: Apply a mismatched WAF policy to valid traffic; detect blocked journeys/assets.
sourceRequiredBehavior: Ensure valid candidate application requests and assets are not unexpectedly blocked.
sourceAcceptance: Unexpected blocks of valid journeys/assets are detected and policy recovery is verified; rules affect only leased routes.
sourceQualification: The original D-S108 acceptance requires real approved sandbox observations on leased routes. This lesson supplies fixed fictional teaching DATA ONLY, not that native proof.
preconditions: Open the complete standalone bundle in a JavaScript-capable browser.
One authored route label and one valid fictional session have three benign request labels.
The complete profile journey requires page, API and script observations; a page 200 alone cannot approve it.
actions: Choose fixed policy and recovery observation fixtures and apply the fictional policy.
Inspect the authored comparison observations and measured journey/request counts.
Restore the baseline policy label; recovery stays unknown.
Measure the authored recovery observations; keep the original comparison failures.
Repeat at most four comparisons or explicitly reset selections, observations and in-memory history.

syntheticInput.observationPolicy: All policy/rule/traffic/asset/routing/authentication observations are fixed fictional teaching DATA ONLY.

expectedAssertions: Applying policy data never counts as an observed successful journey.
A valid API block and a required script block each interrupt the complete journey.
A matched three-request observation is positive; a missing script observation is unknown.
Restoring the baseline label does not establish recovery without measurement.
Measured recovery may be positive, negative or unknown and never erases earlier interruptions.
Strict typed commands and canonical history replay reject forged or out-of-order state without mutation.
Actual browser keyboard, visible error/reset, missing-model failure and CSP checks work.
Normal verification is read-only; deliberate evidence capture is append-only.
limits: No WAF rule evaluation engine, actual policy/resource changes, traffic generation, network calls, auth, routing changes or denial bypasses.
Path/status/rule/session labels are authored data, not observations from Azure or a real sandbox lease.
No credentials, management access, cloud, IaC, scaffolding, identity registration, deployment, packages, framework or spend.
No native-platform support, source-parent acceptance, real propagation/recovery or availability guarantee.
In-memory bounded history is cleared by explicit reset or page reload; no durability claim.
Node 22.23.4 test tooling only; no production Node 24 validation.
Approved offline Playwright 1.56.1 and installed Microsoft-signed Edge 156 only.
Published isolated helper 53c0c0d retains its known overall context/shutdown deadline limitation; the inactive recovery prototype is unqualified.

verification.normalVerification: Read-only. Browser proof capture requires the exact deliberate CAPTURE_BROWSER_EVIDENCE=1.
